note: Gates of the marker-jump rule version 1 (configs/pilot/marker_jump.json), scored by haltere.obstacles.marker_jump_gates (score). Frozen with the rule before any held-out result: before the freeze the rule was run only on its development case (straw-brain11cw13-r4b-noassist-02, 110.5-112.4 s; and the two other development crash windows, where it changed nothing) and on a development harness set (sim seed 5: turn 0/60 deg, half width 1.4 m, false marker 0/16.6 deg; fast PD and fast-brain-11-b-cw13). Before the rule was designed, the round-6 measurement read the request, yaw and course after each checkpoint switch (not the marker gaps) of straw-brain08-04, straw-brain08-06 and the three fast-brain-11-b-cw13 Straw logs, and the gap-aim episodes and GateNet readings of the stack logs; those logs stay in the held-out set for this rule, reported separately as read. Every replay is open loop (the recorded motion does not respond); the windows are semi-closed loop in the identified surrogate; the harness is synthetic. Nothing here is flight evidence. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256.

baseline_tree.note: a git archive of m5 at bc7c71c; its variants run its own haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py

flights_note: every Straw Bale, Minus Two and Pine Valley log of runs/fast-stack-20260923 with a sidecar (straw-brain07-steep-01 has none); a flight with no replayable tick (minus-brain10b-r4-01, minus-fast6-r4-01: stopped at 0 ticks) is reported and scores nothing

replays.streamed_note: the offline looming stream of the round-4/5 replays for the flights flown without looming (stack variants only); every other flight feeds its logged looming samples, if any
replays.bases_note: stack: the m5 stack as the round-5 Straw runs flew it (wall pilot v6, vertical guard v4, gap pilot v5, lag turn v2, descent view v3 with contact support v3, stale evidence v2; no motor assist); default: the default fast race-cue pilot

surrogate.loop: haltere.obstacles.stale_evidence_gates.Surrogate (haltere.train.brake_gates.replay_window): IdentifiedSim of the measured original drone, no randomisation, 3-tick command delay, quadratic drag 0.0075, from the logged state; the request and the yaw stick per logged row from a replay (rows the replay skipped keep the log); a brain warmed on its recorded inputs for warm_s
surrogate.motor_of_flight: the fast PD for a fast_velocity_pd_v1 flight; otherwise the brain whose sha256 prefix (8 hex) is the sidecar's checkpoint_sha256 prefix; flights of other brains (fast-brain-02 to -07, with recorded scene currents, which the surrogate refuses) are scored open loop only (H1, H3 open-loop proxy) and reported
surrogate.window: from pre_s before a changed window's first differing tick to post_s after its last (a change is a request differing by more than 0.05 m/s horizontally or vertically; windows closer than 0.5 s merged), cut at the flight's first velocity jump (impact)

harness.loop: haltere.liftoff.motor_assist_eval.run_scenarios (the fast-brain development gate's closed loop: IdentifiedSim with 10% per-drone randomisation, synthetic HUD marker at 18 Hz with 10% dropout and 0.06 s latency, three-tick command delay, quadratic drag)
harness.pilot: haltere.train.deployed_pilot.deployed_pilot_kwargs(contract, stale_evidence=True): the m5 stack as flown on Straw (no motor assist); rule: plus marker_jump='on'
harness.gate_set_note: motor_assist_eval.gate_scenario (two arches with posts as legs; a false marker false_deg beside the ring after 0.55 s unread within 8 m of the first arch, two captures, then 0.5 s unread); FRESH: parameters and sim seed never run before
harness.hairpin_set_note: motor_assist_eval.hairpin_scenario (the Minus-Two-like hairpin; the marker unread for 0.45 s after the arch pass, so the next ring's marker returns jumped after a gap: the rule's cost); FRESH: never run before

I1_default_off.rule: HELD-OUT (identity): both bases (stack, default) replayed on this tree without the rule equal the m5 tree's replays bit for bit (vertical_replay.COMMAND_KEYS) on every flight with ticks

I2_shadow.rule: HELD-OUT (identity): each base with the rule in shadow equals the base bit for bit on every flight with ticks

D1_start_arch.rule: DEVELOPMENT (measured before the freeze, see the declaration): (a) the rule holds both logged false readings (capture times listed; the rule's marker_held is 1 at their ticks); (b) semi-closed loop from the logged state at t0: the base's replayed requests pass within validation_max_m of the contact point (the drone centre at the audited impact) and the rule's requests pass at least clear_min_m from it, with the path left of it (away from the leg)

D2_other_crashes.rule: DEVELOPMENT (report only): the requests the rule changes inside the development windows of straw-brain11cw13-r5-noassist-01 and -04 (stack base)

H1_no_new_stop.rule: HELD-OUT: in every changed window (padded pre_s/post_s) outside the development windows, both bases: no tick where the rule's horizontal request is below stop_mps while the base's is at or above it

H2_clearance.rule: HELD-OUT, semi-closed loop: every changed window of the stack base outside the development windows, in flights with a surrogate motor: the largest lateral deviation of the rule's surrogate path from the base's (stale_evidence_gates.path_compare) is at most max_lateral_m

H3_course_time.rule: HELD-OUT, per flight, stack base, outside the development windows: the progress the rule's surrogate path loses over its changed windows (the sum of path_compare's progress lost, s) is at most max_fraction of the flight's replayed duration; flights without a surrogate motor use the open-loop proxy: the horizontal request travel the rule removes (integral of |base request| - |rule request|, where positive) is at most max_fraction of the base's

HG1_gate_posts.rule: HELD-OUT (fresh harness set): per motor over the gate set, post contacts with the rule <= without

HG2_gate_finishes.rule: HELD-OUT (fresh harness set): per motor over the gate set, finished scenarios with the rule >= without

HG3_gate_quiet.rule: HELD-OUT (fresh harness set): per motor, the scenarios without a false marker: the mean finish time of the scenarios both variants finish is at most max_time_fraction slower with the rule, and no scenario whose lowest horizontal speed near the arches (gate_min_speed) is at or above stop_mps without the rule falls below it with the rule

HG4_hairpin.rule: HELD-OUT (fresh harness set): per motor over the hairpin set, wall contacts with the rule <= without and clean passes (finished, no wall, floor or ceiling contact, no crash) >= without
